cases.title: Qwen3.5-0.8B SFT：EOS 与 padding 共用 ID 时丢失结尾标签
cases.scope: PAD 与 EOS 共用 ID 时，原生 collator 丢失了全部 100 个结束标签。按注意力掩码恢复标签后，两端均恢复 100 个 EOS，前向 logits 不变，填充仍不计入损失。

title.en: Qwen3.5-0.8B SFT: EOS labels with shared EOS and padding IDs

title.en: Qwen3.5-2B SFT: token weighting and gradient accumulation
title.zh: Qwen3.5-2B SFT：token 加权与梯度累积

summary.en: Default Trainer weighted uneven microbatches equally. The tested 910C stack also divided backward gradients by the accumulation count. The repaired configurations matched the independent objective and gradient checks.
summary.zh: 默认 Trainer 对有效 token 数不同的微批等权平均；实测 910C 软件栈还在反向额外除以累积步数。修复配置通过了独立目标函数和梯度复核。

title.en: LFM2.5-1.2B SFT: verify full-window loss and update
title.zh: LFM2.5-1.2B SFT：全窗口损失与参数更新

summary.en: On Transformers 5.23.0, both stacks used full-window token weighting and agreed with their independent objective and gradient checks. On the same 910C card, the older tested stack applied an extra backward divisor of 34.
summary.zh: Transformers 5.23.0 在两端均按整个累积窗口的有效 token 加权，目标函数和梯度通过独立复核。 同一张 910C 上，旧版软件栈的反向额外除以 34。

title.en: LFM2.5 SFT DDP: unequal rank token counts
title.zh: LFM2.5 SFT DDP：两卡 token 数不等

summary.en: Global valid-token weighting agreed with an independent rank contribution replay on HCCL and NCCL. Disabling cross-rank token weighting changed the gradient on both stacks.
summary.zh: HCCL 和 NCCL 下的全局 token 加权均通过独立梯度复核；关闭跨 rank 加权会改变两端的梯度。

title.en: Qwen3.5-0.8B SFT: EOS labels with shared EOS and padding IDs
title.zh: Qwen3.5-0.8B SFT：EOS 与 padding 共用 ID 时丢失结尾标签

summary.en: The original collator dropped all 100 EOS targets when PAD shared the EOS ID. A mask-aware label change restored all 100 and preserved the original forward logits and padding mask on 910C and B200.
summary.zh: PAD 与 EOS 共用 ID 时，原生 collator 丢失了全部 100 个结束标签。按注意力掩码恢复标签后，两端均恢复 100 个 EOS，前向 logits 不变，填充仍不计入损失。

title.en: Qwen3-1.7B SFT checkpoint resume on Ascend 910C and B200
title.zh: Qwen3-1.7B SFT：Ascend 910C 与 B200 的 checkpoint 恢复

summary.en: On each platform, resuming from update 2 exactly matched uninterrupted updates 3 to 5 for sample order, RNG states, full vocabulary logits, LoRA gradients, updates and AdamW moments. On Ascend, one of 15 logged loss values differed by 2.38e-7 nats, with the same FP64 replay value. Turning off data skipping changed the next batch and gradient.
summary.zh: 两端分别从第 2 步 checkpoint 恢复，后 3 步的样本顺序、随机数状态、全词表 logits、LoRA 梯度与参数及 AdamW 状态逐位一致。Ascend 的 15 个原生 loss 中，有 1 个相差 2.38e-7 nats，FP64 复算值相同。关闭数据跳过后，下一批样本和梯度发生变化。

title.en: Qwen3-0.6B SFT document packing on Ascend 910C and B200
title.zh: Qwen3-0.6B SFT：Ascend 910C 与 B200 的文档打包

summary.en: TRL BFD preserved completion and EOS labels and isolated every packed document in all 28 layers. The isolated and packed layouts still produced different BF16 scores and LoRA updates; the traces show where the measurements first diverged.
summary.zh: TRL BFD 保留了续写和结束标签，28 层均隔离文档。打包与逐文档训练的 BF16 分数和 LoRA 更新仍有差异，逐层追踪记录了首个分叉。

title.en: Qwen3.5-0.8B SFT activation checkpointing on Ascend 910C and B200
title.zh: Qwen3.5-0.8B SFT：Ascend 910C 与 B200 的激活重算

summary.en: With RNG preservation enabled, the captured dropout outputs, target logits and LoRA update matched ordinary backward on both stacks. Disabling RNG preservation changed dropout outputs on replay.
summary.zh: 开启 RNG 保留时，两端采集的 Dropout 输出、目标 logits 和 LoRA 更新均与普通反传一致。主动关闭 RNG 保留后，重算得到不同的 Dropout 输出。

summary.zh: 双端均完成 100 个事件、10 次优化器更新，并观察下一轮原生采样读取更新后的策略。两端各自同时采到 A 和 B、且奖励有方差的组至少 3 个；固定轨迹用于对齐首步梯度和更新。

title.en: Qwen3.5-2B SFT: token weighting and gradient accumulation
title.zh: Qwen3.5-2B SFT：token 加权与梯度累积

summary.en: Default Trainer weighted uneven microbatches equally. The tested 910C stack also divided backward gradients by the accumulation count. The repaired configurations matched the independent objective and gradient checks.
summary.zh: 默认 Trainer 对有效 token 数不同的微批等权平均；实测 910C 软件栈还在反向额外除以累积步数。修复配置通过了独立目标函数和梯度复核。

title.en: LFM2.5-1.2B SFT: verify full-window loss and update
title.zh: LFM2.5-1.2B SFT：全窗口损失与参数更新

summary.en: On Transformers 5.23.0, both stacks used full-window token weighting and agreed with their independent objective and gradient checks. On the same 910C card, the older tested stack applied an extra backward divisor of 34.
summary.zh: Transformers 5.23.0 在两端均按整个累积窗口的有效 token 加权，目标函数和梯度通过独立复核。 同一张 910C 上，旧版软件栈的反向额外除以 34。

title.en: LFM2.5 SFT DDP: unequal rank token counts
title.zh: LFM2.5 SFT DDP：两卡 token 数不等

summary.en: Global valid-token weighting agreed with an independent rank contribution replay on HCCL and NCCL. Disabling cross-rank token weighting changed the gradient on both stacks.
summary.zh: HCCL 和 NCCL 下的全局 token 加权均通过独立梯度复核；关闭跨 rank 加权会改变两端的梯度。

title.en: Qwen3.5-0.8B SFT: EOS labels with shared EOS and padding IDs
title.zh: Qwen3.5-0.8B SFT：EOS 与 padding 共用 ID 时丢失结尾标签

summary.en: The original collator dropped all 100 EOS targets when PAD shared the EOS ID. A mask-aware label change restored all 100 and preserved the original forward logits and padding mask on 910C and B200.
summary.zh: PAD 与 EOS 共用 ID 时，原生 collator 丢失了全部 100 个结束标签。按注意力掩码恢复标签后，两端均恢复 100 个 EOS，前向 logits 不变，填充仍不计入损失。

title.en: Qwen3-1.7B SFT checkpoint resume on Ascend 910C and B200
title.zh: Qwen3-1.7B SFT：Ascend 910C 与 B200 的 checkpoint 恢复

summary.en: On each platform, resuming from update 2 exactly matched uninterrupted updates 3 to 5 for sample order, RNG states, full vocabulary logits, LoRA gradients, updates and AdamW moments. On Ascend, one of 15 logged loss values differed by 2.38e-7 nats, with the same FP64 replay value. Turning off data skipping changed the next batch and gradient.
summary.zh: 两端分别从第 2 步 checkpoint 恢复，后 3 步的样本顺序、随机数状态、全词表 logits、LoRA 梯度与参数及 AdamW 状态逐位一致。Ascend 的 15 个原生 loss 中，有 1 个相差 2.38e-7 nats，FP64 复算值相同。关闭数据跳过后，下一批样本和梯度发生变化。

title.en: Qwen3-0.6B SFT document packing on Ascend 910C and B200
title.zh: Qwen3-0.6B SFT：Ascend 910C 与 B200 的文档打包

summary.en: TRL BFD preserved completion and EOS labels and isolated every packed document in all 28 layers. The isolated and packed layouts still produced different BF16 scores and LoRA updates; the traces show where the measurements first diverged.
summary.zh: TRL BFD 保留了续写和结束标签，28 层均隔离文档。打包与逐文档训练的 BF16 分数和 LoRA 更新仍有差异，逐层追踪记录了首个分叉。

title.en: Qwen3.5-0.8B SFT activation checkpointing on Ascend 910C and B200
title.zh: Qwen3.5-0.8B SFT：Ascend 910C 与 B200 的激活重算

summary.en: With RNG preservation enabled, the captured dropout outputs, target logits and LoRA update matched ordinary backward on both stacks. Disabling RNG preservation changed dropout outputs on replay.
summary.zh: 开启 RNG 保留时，两端采集的 Dropout 输出、目标 logits 和 LoRA 更新均与普通反传一致。主动关闭 RNG 保留后，重算得到不同的 Dropout 输出。

title.en: SFT gradients were divided twice by the capture setup
title.zh: SFT 测评配置把梯度多除了一次

summary.en: The test set the accumulation length in both Trainer and Accelerate. Leaving Accelerate at the Trainer default removes the extra division; the BF16 forward scores are unchanged.
summary.zh: 原测评同时设置了 Trainer 与 Accelerate 的累加步数。恢复 Trainer 的默认分工后，梯度缩放修正，BF16 前向分数保持不变。

title.zh: DAPO 累积时保留打分行位置
title.en: Preserve scorer row positions during DAPO accumulation

summary.zh: 固定 100 题轨迹；910C 候选在首个共同状态的 120 个动作分数完全对齐，抽样参数更新 RMSE 从 3.22e-6 降至 4.48e-7。仍有局部更新差异。
summary.en: On the original 100-event frozen workload, all 120 initial action scores agreed and sampled update RMSE fell from 3.22e-6 to 4.48e-7. A sampled update outlier remains.
